# API coverage

<!-- generated by go run ./hack/apicoverage; do not edit -->

Every writable (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) path template in the pinned OpenAPI snapshot of each supported
OpenBao minor is classified exactly once in `api-coverage/classification.yaml`:

- **typed**: a kind of this operator configures the object behind the path.
- **Endpoint only**: configuration without a typed kind; use the `OpenBaoEndpoint` kind.
  **unreviewed** paths are Endpoint only paths that nobody has classified yet.
- **action**: a one-off operation, not configuration (login, issue, sign, rotate, revoke, tidy, ...).

`go test ./test/apicoverage/...` fails when a writable path is unclassified or classified twice, when a
typed entry names a kind without a CRD in `config/crd/bases`, or when this file is stale.

The snapshots `api-coverage/openapi-<minor>.json` come from `bao server -dev` with every builtin auth
method and secrets engine mounted at its default path (kv v2 at `secret/`, kv v1 at `kv/`), fetched with
`sys/internal/specs/openapi?generic_mount_paths=true` so mount paths appear as `{<type>_mount_path}`. Add or
refresh a minor with `hack/apicoverage/snapshot.sh <bao-binary> api-coverage/openapi-<minor>.json`, classify
the new paths, then run `go run ./hack/apicoverage`. Kinds for engines that are external plugins in a
release (for example AWS, GCP, or LDAP on 2.7) are outside that release's snapshot.

## Coverage per release

| OpenBao | writable paths | typed | Endpoint only | unreviewed | action | typed share of configuration |
|---------|----------------|-------|---------------|------------|--------|------------------------------|
| 2.6.5 | 377 | 120 (31.8%) | 8 (2.1%) | 0 (0.0%) | 249 (66.0%) | 93.8% |
| 2.7.2 | 352 | 106 (30.1%) | 9 (2.6%) | 0 (0.0%) | 237 (67.3%) | 92.2% |

Typed share of configuration is typed / (typed + Endpoint only + unreviewed): actions are not
configuration and are left out.

## Endpoint-only paths

Configuration paths without a typed kind. Manage them with the `OpenBaoEndpoint` kind; each is a candidate
for a typed kind.

| path | OpenBao | reason |
|------|---------|--------|
| `/cubbyhole/{path}` | 2.6, 2.7 | token-scoped storage: data written there is visible only to the operator's own token |
| `/sys/external-keys/configs/{config}` | 2.7 | needs a KMS plugin; bao server -dev does not load one |
| `/sys/external-keys/configs/{config}/keys/{key}` | 2.7 | needs a KMS plugin; bao server -dev does not load one |
| `/sys/external-keys/configs/{config}/keys/{key}/grants/{mount}` | 2.7 | needs a KMS plugin; bao server -dev does not load one |
| `/sys/loggers` | 2.6, 2.7 | sets the level of every logger at once; Logger manages one named logger |
| `/sys/raw` | 2.6, 2.7 | raw storage access, break-glass only; deliberately untyped |
| `/sys/raw/{path}` | 2.6, 2.7 | raw storage access, break-glass only; deliberately untyped |
| `/{ldap_mount_path}/library/{name}` | 2.6 | external plugin library set; not tested until the plugin is in CI |
| `/{openldap_mount_path}/library/{name}` | 2.6 | external plugin library set; not tested until the plugin is in CI |
| `/{ssh_mount_path}/config/zeroaddress` | 2.6, 2.7 | allowlist of roles that may use any source address; set it with OpenBaoEndpoint |
| `/{ssh_mount_path}/issuer/{issuer_ref}` | 2.6, 2.7 | renames or deletes an issuer; SSHCA owns the default CA through config/ca |
